adjudication.rationale: The diff does remove the global `embed_category` site setting (`config/site_settings.yml`) and deletes it in the migration (`DELETE FROM site_settings WHERE name IN ('embeddable_hosts', 'embed_category')`). It also changes `TopicEmbed.import` to select the post category solely from the embeddable-host record matching the entry URL host (`eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` then `category: eh.try(:category_id)`). From the diff alone, that implies any `TopicEmbed.import` call where `record_for_host(url)` returns nil will no longer have a configured category and will fall back to whatever `PostCreator` does with a nil category (likely uncategorized). The specific claim about the RSS feed poller calling `TopicEmbed.import` with feed-entry URLs is plausible but not shown in this diff, so the regression impact can’t be fully verified here.
